conversion: FFmpeg 9.0.2 mono / 16 kHz; onset trim retaining 2 ms; measured fundamental alignment by linear interpolation; 1 ms onset and 20 ms end cosine fades; fixed asset peak 29000 before generator centering and mip filtering. No output audition normalization. Ensemble attack trim uses the first 50%-of-first-400-ms-peak crossing, retaining 2 ms, to align the actual section strokes. Brass targets C4 and strings C6; the source end is zero-padded for the transposed string one-shot.
